title: Migrate all branch policy, repository policy, and approvalsandchecks resources to terraform-plugin-framework
essence: 20 SDKv2 resources (7 branch policy, 7 repository policy, 6 approvalsandchecks) are now served via the mux provider using terraform-plugin-framework. Gap matrices (docs/policy-gap-matrix.md and docs/approvalsandchecks-gap-matrix.md) document API parity. Live acceptance tests re-run 2026-07-03 (after 14:45Z rework window) with TF_ACC=1 confirming all three resource families produce real policy/check configurations in ADO. REST GET evidence captured for branch_policy (min_reviewers id=262), repository_policy (max_file_size id=263), and check (approval id=115) families.
